id: E5 - one-time final test of frozen MINT (R1, dense counterfactual) against the D-56 comparison set on the OPV2V test split
written: 2026-10-24, after the E5a development check on block T (development / in-sample) and before any test-scenario byte is downloaded for E5. NOT RUN: the stream needs the user's explicit approval.
frozen_code_note: All code that produces the E5 numbers is at this commit. sha256 of the key files below. Nothing in them changes after this file is committed; if something must change, E5 stops and is reported.
user_decisions: D-55 (final test set) and D-56 (comparison set), recorded as proposed entries in commit 03b512f before any E5a code ran; D-51 (frozen method), D-54 (scope statement)

data.set: OPV2V test split minus 2021_08_23_12_58_19 (development per the exposure ledger) = 15 scenarios (D-55); Culver City not used
data.prior_exposure: detector-level only (Stage-1 V-01: clean AttFuse outputs and AP for all 16 test scenarios). No MINT, baseline, attack or oracle outcome has been computed on any test scenario.
data.archive: the OPV2V test archive streamed in Stage-1 V-01: runners/stage1_reproduce.TEST_URL (box file id f_1621736219709), the request's 'test-012.zip'; members under test/<allowlisted scenario>/ only; read with HTTP ranged reads (tools/ranged_zip.py); the validate archive is never contacted

methods_D56.ego_only: baselines.ego_only: finalize(cands[all senders excluded]) (= Y+ when n = 1)
methods_D56.B-RAY: baselines.b_ray on the final Y+ (no counterfactual): per box, the receiver's std ray counts (rays.classify_points, the R1 code); drop iff KNOWN (>= 3 rays, not the receiver's own box) and Wilson-95 upper bound of s = SUP/(SUP+TRAV) < 0.5 (R1's ADD gate); counts from the float64 receiver scan in the stream (`yplus_rays`). Applied at every n, including n = 1.
methods_D56.R1_headline: MINT-v0 + R1 (D-40, D-51): r1.assess with v0.Params() (n_min 3, std), dense counterfactual, finalize(compose(cands, gating_choice)), UNKNOWN = keep; unchanged since E4 (r1.py / v0.py / pipeline.py sha256 equal to the E4 pre-registration)
methods_D56.R1_noREMOVE: ablation, baselines.assess_noremove: R1 with REMOVE gate verdicts replaced by 'none'; mirror (useful) conditions unchanged
methods_D56.bounds: e0_analyze.frame_policies: oracle_attacker (gate attacker units with D > 0.5) and vis_oracle_attacker (KNOWN attacker units only); bounds, not methods
methods_D56.T(0.05): cost variant of R1 only (D-51), timed, never used for an accuracy number

attacks.as_E4: attacker = sender 1; families spoof_feat, remove_feat, shift_feat, spoof_pts (the 4 original) + spoof_blind; implementation and seeds exactly as the E4 pre-registration (e4_stream.frame_record): np.random.seed(stage1_reproduce.frame_seed(scen, i, 0)); attack rng = e0_stream.rng_for(family, scen, frame, 0)

E4_attack_spec.spoof_blind: src/mint/attacks/blind.py attack_spoof_blind (evaluation only, frozen after the block-T development run): spoof_feat with the destination restricted to free patches where the source GT box translated by the patch shift has < 3 receiver rays (SUP + TRAV, rays.classify_points on the receiver's scan) and is not the receiver's own box; up to 300 random destination draws; not applied if none found. The attacker is assumed to know the receiver's visibility (worst case). Expected R1 recovery ~ 0; it measures the known bypass.

attacks.population: every frame of the 15 scenarios under clean + 5 families; a family on a frame where the attack was not applied, or a frame with n = 1, is evaluated as clean (as E0-E4)

primary.metric: mean over the 4 original families of dAP@0.7 = AP@0.7(R1) - AP@0.7(no defense); OpenCOOD AP (global_sort_detections = False, IoU 0.7), frames pooled in (scenario, frame) order
primary.ci_primary: scenario-block paired bootstrap: the 15 scenarios resampled with replacement, 2000 resamples, seed 0, 95% percentile CI; resampled frames keep their (scenario, frame) order (e5_analyze.bootstrap kind 'scenario')
primary.ci_secondary: contiguous 10-frame blocks within each scenario, resampled within scenario (stratified), 2000 resamples, seed 0 (kind 'block10', as E4)
primary.clean: clean relative AP@0.7 loss 1 - AP_clean(R1) / AP_clean(no defense), both CIs

success_criteria.a: scenario-bootstrap CI lower bound of the primary metric > 0
success_criteria.b: scenario-bootstrap CI upper bound of the clean relative loss <= 0.01
success_criteria.not_criteria: per-family deltas, spoof_blind, strata, bounds and cost are reported, not judged

key_secondary.metric: R1 - B-RAY paired dAP@0.7 = AP@0.7(R1) - AP@0.7(B-RAY), mean over the 4 original families, scenario-bootstrap 95% CI (10-frame CI also reported); per family too
key_secondary.rule: if the scenario CI includes 0, the report must state: 'the counterfactual's benefit over a box-level filter is not established' (e5_analyze.criteria -> required_statement)

other_secondary: all methods x (clean + 5 families): AP@0.7, AP@0.5, dAP vs no defense, clean relative loss, recovery (None if attack loss < 0.005); R1 - R1_noREMOVE and R1 - ego_only paired deltas; oracle bounds; R1 / noREMOVE unit breakdown (KNOWN/UNKNOWN/self, gated, precision, false rejections of USEFUL units by effect type); B-RAY box outcomes (dropped, dropped boxes matching GT at BEV IoU >= 0.5); attack realization

stratification_by_agents.strata: n = 2, n = 3, n >= 4 (frame's agent count); n = 1 frames are in the pooled analysis and reported as a count, not a stratum
stratification_by_agents.dAP: per stratum: point mean dAP@0.7 (4 original families) and clean relative loss for every method, paired R1 - B-RAY, R1 per-family deltas; 10-frame-block bootstrap within the stratum; scenario bootstrap only if >= 5 scenarios contribute frames (expected from Stage-1 metadata: n = 2 about 9 scenarios, n = 3 about 9, n >= 4 two scenarios, so no scenario CI for 4+). Descriptive; no criterion
stratification_by_agents.overhead: per stratum (and n = 1): D-42 overhead p50/p95 with both denominators for dense R1 and T(0.05) (e4_stream.time_frame, unchanged) and B-RAY (e5_stream.time_bray: same baseline-only repetition, then B-RAY on the plain output). MINT is not timed at n = 1 (no senders; overhead 0 by construction). Reported, no pass/fail (D-50). Apple M1 CPU, torch 8 intra-op / 1 inter-op threads, 3 interleaved repetitions, per-frame median

scope_limits_D54: reported next to the headline: spoof_blind (visibility-aware spoofer) loss and recovery for every method, with its bounds; n-coverage: the held-out evidence before this test covered n = 2 only (block H), the test covers n = 1-5 with few n >= 4 frames from 2 scenarios

streaming.runner: runners/e5_stream.py --run_dir runs/20261024-E5 --user_approved (refuses without the flag; refuses any scenario outside the allowlist, incl. 2021_08_23_12_58_19 and every validate scenario)
streaming.budget_check: after reading only the archive's central directory and before the first data byte: already-downloaded + 1.01 x sum of the member sizes of all scenarios still to fetch <= 22e9, else refuse (0 bytes); re-checked per scenario (counted at full size) and after each download
streaming.disk: one scenario on disk at a time; raw <= 3e9 bytes (largest test scenario 2.62e9 raw in Stage 1); free disk >= member size + 5e9 before each download
streaming.deletion: raw deleted after the scenario cache is written, re-read and its compose checks verified
streaming.stop: stop if the budget would be exceeded, a non-allowlisted scenario would be touched, or a compose check fails

estimated_runtime.download: about 0.5 h at the E4 rate (11.6 MB/s)
estimated_runtime.processing: about 7.5 h (data pass ~4 s/frame at n = 2, ~7 s at n = 3, ~13 s at n = 4, ~25 s at n = 5 (extrapolated); timing pass ~5.6 s/frame at n = 2 rising to ~10 s at n = 5); 2021_08_22_07_52_02 (n = 4-5) alone ~1.4 h
estimated_runtime.total: about 8 h (range 7-10 h); analysis (e5_analyze.py test, 2000-resample bootstraps) under 1 h
estimated_runtime.basis: E0/E4 stream logs on the same machine; estimate only

analysis: python runners/e5_analyze.py test --run_dir runs/20261024-E5 -> runs/20261024-E5/e5_test.json (criteria, key secondary, strata, overhead)

outcome.success: report R1 as the headline with the key-secondary statement (if triggered) and the D-54 scope limits
outcome.failure: report the failure as the result; no rescue analysis is presented as confirmatory
outcome.no_rule_changes: no change to any method, attack, metric or criterion after this file is committed, in either case

bug_fixes_before_freeze: e5_stream: the T(0.05) timing path (pipeline.mint_frame cf_mode='trigger') crashes at n = 1 (no senders: empty torch.cat); found in a dev-slice smoke test with forced n = 1, before any dev-check number; fixed by not timing MINT at n = 1 (pipeline.py unchanged)

e5_stream: the timing progress print assumed a dense timing record (KeyError at n = 1); found by running run_scenario end-to-end on the 24-frame dev slice with forced n = 1; fixed. After both fixes run_scenario completed on the dev slice at n = 2 (24 frames, 3/3 compose checks identical) and forced n = 1 (24 frames)
deviation_notes: B-RAY ray counts in the dev check were computed from the cached float16 receiver scan (the block-T caches have no float64 scan); checked against the cached float64 counts on every clean ADD/SHIFT Y+ box (see e5a_dev.json ray_count_check_dev). In the test they come from the float64 scan in the stream.
The block-T caches have no per-frame baseline timing, so the dev B-RAY cost is reported in seconds only; the test measures B-RAY overhead with the D-42 protocol.
labelling: Test numbers are the one-time final test. All E0-E5a numbers (blocks T and H) are development or held-out-but-exposed and are reported separately.
no_changes: decision_log.md is not edited; proposals go to planning/decision_log_proposed_appendix.md only
